description: This file is a PHP script that initializes a web page for managing requirement specifications within a test management project. It handles session variables, checks user rights, and prepares data for rendering with a Smarty template.

classes.name: stdClass
classes.description: A generic PHP class used here for simple data objects to pass data structures around.

classes.name: TLSmarty
classes.description: A class representing the Smarty template engine, used to assign data and render templates.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks whether the user has the necessary rights (view or modify requirements) in the current project context.
